name: human-attribution
title: Human-only commit attribution
summary: Commits carry the responsible human's identity only: hooks and CI reject AI-tool/bot authors, co-author trailers and session links, and Claude Code's auto-attribution is switched off.
when: Your team or client policy says AI tools are tools, not contributors (common for coursework, competitions and client repos).
next: Set your own identity: git config user.name "Your Name" && git config user.email you@example.com
Hooks run from .githooks (npm install sets core.hooksPath). Do not bypass with --no-verify.
